name: C Note Bar & Lounge
bio: C Note Bar & Lounge, formerly the Keynote Lounge, is a bar on Telephone Road in East Ventura with patio seating and TVs. It hosts karaoke on Sunday nights.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from the C Note Bar & Lounge Facebook and @keynotelounge.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
